description: Review point m9: re-run the T2 gap-filling protocol verbatim (identical stations, components, seeds, gap lengths and gap layout to exp-20261008-classical-baselines / exp-20261008-dl-baselines) but score every filler against BOTH the withheld observation y (what the station recorded, correlated noise included) and the noise-free signal S. A filler that reproduces part of the correlated noise looks artificially good against y; one that recovers the underlying signal looks good against S. Reproduces the registered t2_* numbers as a by-product.
